sections.prior_heading: Unfavorable general economic and geopolitical conditions could negatively impact our financial results.
sections.current_heading: Unfavorable general economic and geopolitical conditions could negatively impact our financial results.
diff: replace: [conflicts, including the conflict between Russia and Ukraine and conflicts in the Middle East.] -> [conflicts.]
replace: [tariffs;] -> [tariffs, including tariffs that increase suppliers’ sourcing costs;]
sections.description: The named conflicts (Russia and Ukraine, the Middle East) behind the operational disruption are dropped in favor of generic 'international conflicts', tariffs that increase suppliers' sourcing costs are added as an exposure, and 'intensified inflation throughout 2024' becomes 'high rates of inflation throughout 2025'.

A.rationale: criterion 2: specific named conflicts are dropped; criterion 1 also applies because supplier sourcing-cost tariffs are a newly disclosed exposure.

B.rationale: criterion 2: specific named conflicts are dropped, and criterion 1: a new exposure (tariffs raising suppliers' sourcing costs) is disclosed, so the section is material even though the year changes are routine.

sections.prior_heading: If we are not successful in our innovation activities, our financial results may be negatively affected.
sections.current_heading: If we are not successful in our innovation activities, our financial results may be negatively affected.
sections.description: The only change is inserting 'among other factors' before the list of things innovation success depends on.

A.rationale: minor: a stylistic hedge marking the list as non-exhaustive, with no new factor, risk or characterization introduced.

B.rationale: Minor: a stylistic hedge that marks the existing list as non-exhaustive without naming any new risk, factor or change in likelihood or severity.

sections.prior_heading: Changes in the retail landscape or the loss of key retail or foodservice customers could adversely affect our financial results.
sections.current_heading: Changes in the retail landscape or the loss of key customers could adversely affect our financial results.
sections.description: The customer-loss risk is broadened from 'key retail or foodservice customers' to 'key customers' in both the headline and the body.

A.rationale: criterion 3: the scope of the customer dependency is widened by removing the retail and foodservice qualifier.

B.rationale: criterion 3: the scope of the disclosed customer-loss risk is widened from two named customer types to all key customers.

diff: insert: [] -> [including tariffs that increase suppliers’ sourcing costs,]
sections.description: Tariffs that increase suppliers' sourcing costs are added to the list of factors driving input price volatility, alongside a 2025 to 2026 roll-forward and minor rewording ('derived' to 'derived and manufactured', 'that we use' to 'used').

A.rationale: criterion 1: supplier sourcing-cost tariffs are a newly disclosed exposure; the rest is roll-forward and stylistic.

B.rationale: criterion 1: a new cost exposure (tariffs raising suppliers' sourcing costs) is disclosed, which makes the section material despite the otherwise routine edits.
